lead: The features that mattered most to the model for this answer were:
supporting_factor: {feature} was {strength}, and it pointed the model toward this answer.
opposing_factor: {feature} was {strength}, and it pointed the model away from this answer.
neutral_factor: {feature} did not clearly push the model toward or away from this answer.
scope: These clues can change when checked again. They help describe the model's answer but do not prove what caused it.
mask_explanation: The highlighted areas show which parts of the image were related to the model's answer. A highlight does not mean that area caused the condition.
